## Who is Panger Lkr?

Panger Lkr, full legal name Pangerkumzuk Longkumer, is a cybersecurity expert and entrepreneur from Kohima, Nagaland, India.
He is the founder and CEO of NexusCipherGuard India, a cybersecurity firm based in Nagaland, and the acquirer of Aegis Mind Technologies, a tech company based in Bangalore, India.
He is also a Cybersecurity Advisor at MMB Cyber School, a community-led non-profit focused on digital literacy and cyber awareness.

## Core Areas of Expertise

- Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment (VAPT)
- Zero-Trust Architecture Design
- Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting
- Social Engineering Simulations
- Network Security & Hardening
- Ethical Hacking
- Encryption & Cryptography
- Risk Advisory & Security Consulting
- Digital Defence Strategy
